The strong chromatic splitting conjecture

About 7 years old · traced to 2019

Let En−1E_{n-1}En−1​-local spectra be localized with respect to Morava EEE-theory, let Sp0S_p^0Sp0​ be the ppp-complete sphere spectrum, and let

ΛR(X1,…,Xn)\Lambda_R(X_1,\ldots,X_n)ΛR​(X1​,…,Xn​)

denote the exterior-algebra-type wedge of RRR and all smash products of distinct listed spectra over RRR. Strong chromatic splitting conjecture. If p≠2p\neq2p=2, or if p=2p=2p=2 and nnn is odd, then there is an equivalence

Ln−1LK(n)S0≃ΛLn−1Sp0(Ln−iS1−2i:1≤i≤n)L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S^0\simeq\Lambda_{L_{n-1}S_p^0}(L_{n-i}S^{1-2i}:1\leq i\leq n)Ln−1​LK(n)​S0≃ΛLn−1​Sp0​​(Ln−i​S1−2i:1≤i≤n)

in the category of En−1E_{n-1}En−1​-local spectra, with ι\iotaι corresponding to the unit. If p=2p=2p=2 and nnn is even, then there is an En−1E_{n-1}En−1​-local equivalence

Ln−1LK(n)S0≃ΛLn−1S20(Ln−iS1−2i:1≤i≤n)∧ΛLn−1S20(Ln−1S−2/2),L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S^0\simeq\Lambda_{L_{n-1}S_2^0}(L_{n-i}S^{1-2i}:1\leq i\leq n)\wedge\Lambda_{L_{n-1}S_2^0}(L_{n-1}S^{-2}/2),Ln−1​LK(n)​S0≃ΛLn−1​S20​​(Ln−i​S1−2i:1≤i≤n)∧ΛLn−1​S20​​(Ln−1​S−2/2),

with ι∧ι\iota\wedge\iotaι∧ι corresponding to the unit. This is a proposed revision of the original conjecture, incorporating the additional class at p=n=2p=n=2p=n=2. It implies the weak chromatic splitting conjecture; the source notes that the weak form holds for finite spectra but fails for the ppp-completion of BPBPBP.
